title: Quick Roasted Peruvian Chicken
description: A simplified version of the classic Peruvian dish, Pollo a la Brasa, featuring a crispy roasted exterior and juicy interior. This recipe serves four and is ready in under an hour.

ingredients.name: aipom paste
ingredients.notes: Or substitute with Peruvian yellow chili paste

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine aipom paste, garlic, cilantro, salt, black pepper, and paprika; blend until smooth.
Rub the spice paste all over the chicken, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice; add the chicken and toss to coat.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper; arrange the chicken on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
After 35 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil; cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the chicken is nicely browned.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired; serve with sliced red onion and additional cilantro, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
